title: Some Generalized Numerical Ranges of Real-linear Operators on Hilbert Spaces
summary: This paper introduces and systematically investigates several classes of numerical ranges associated with real-linear operators on Hilbert spaces, including the essential numerical range, maximal numerical range, essential maximal numerical range, $q$-numerical range, and trace numerical range. We establish fundamental structural properties of these sets and characterize their geometric shape.
